title: Owner mailing-address data for Hawaii County and Kauai County - availability search, request guide, and partial public aggregates

status.hawaii_county: NOT FOUND - no public layer/table with owner mailing city/state/ZIP/country; County RPT services are token-gated and the RPT website is behind a Cloudflare challenge (not bypassed).
status.kauai_county: NOT FOUND - no public layer/table with owner mailing fields; County RPA website (qPublic) and kauai.gov are blocked (connection reset / Akamai 403); County ArcGIS layers carry first owner NAME only (OWN1).
status.statewide: NOT FOUND - State GIS Program (geodata.hawaii.gov, files.hawaii.gov OP downloads, geoportal.hawaii.gov, opendata.hawaii.gov) publishes county parcel layers without owner mailing fields; its metadata marks the county OWNER field 'NOT TO BE DISTRIBUTED TO PUBLIC'.

Only the partial indicators in 'partial_public_aggregates' are available.

arcgis_online_keyword_searches.result: Third-party layers with owner MAILING fields exist only for Maui County (e.g. PBR 'Hana_Basemap' mautmk_2023_04_fullowner; UH student Lahaina layers; Maui County staff copies of the parcel fabric) and Oahu (HoLIS). Third-party Hawaii County / Kauai parcel copies (State DLNR TMK_Hawaii/TMK_Kauai, DBEDT_PuuWaaWaa, School_Borders_Hawaii, South Kona scenarios, PBR kautmk_2018_5mile, UH Hawaii_County_Parcels_2020, jtsmolinski/509rbssga24 homeowner parcels) carry owner NAME / MajorOwner / homeowner only. Esri Living Atlas has no public owner-mailing parcel layer for Hawaii. The only public non-county source with a mailing-address-based measure is Regrid's tract-level aggregate (used below; it has no Kauai tracts).

hawaii_county.office: County of Hawaii, Department of Finance - Real Property Tax Office (Hilo and Kona); GIS: County IT/Planning GIS (owner of the token-gated gis.hawaiicounty.gov RPT and Planning_TaxMapping services).
hawaii_county.ask_for: Bulk export of the current certified/working real property roll owner table with the tax-bill MAILING address split into fields (mailing street, city, state, ZIP5, country, care-of), keyed by 12/13-digit TMK incl. CPR unit, plus tax class (PittCode labels) and homeowner-exemption flag; or (privacy-preserving alternative) counts by TMK zone/section x mailing state/country x tax class x CPR-unit flag. Alternatively request a token / public view of the RPT folder services on gis.hawaiicounty.gov.
hawaii_county.note: hawaiipropertytax.com historically offered downloadable roll/owner files; it is behind a Cloudflare challenge from this environment, so a person with a normal browser may be able to download them directly (check the site's terms).

how_to_request.fallback_commercial: Regrid, ATTOM, CoreLogic/Cotality and similar vendors license parcel files with mailing fields for both counties (not used; licensing required).

caveats: THIRD-PARTY, ~2023 vintage, not the county roll; definition = residential (USPS RDI 'Y') parcels with >= 1 building; 'out of state' = tax-bill mailing state != HI. Whether foreign addresses are counted as out-of-state is not documented (likely yes if mail_state is blank).
Kauai: the layer has ZERO Kauai (15007) tracts - no Kauai estimate is possible from it.

Hawaii County: only 35 tracts / 23277 homes are present. Zones with no tracts: Zone 3 - North Hilo, Zone 9 - Kau. Puna (zone 1) has 5 tracts with 771 homes vs 23139 improved parcels in cohRPT2026 (3% coverage). See coverage_homes_per_improved_parcel by zone. The county total is therefore NOT representative of the island.
Hawaii County parcels are 9-digit TMKs without CPR units, so condo units are not separate 'homes' in Regrid for Hawaii County (each condo lot counts once); no condo vs non-condo split is possible.

The layer's percent fields (peroutst/peroutzip/combo) are internally inconsistent (e.g. peroutzip = 1 - peroutst in some tracts); all shares here are recomputed from the count fields (outstate/homes; (outzip - outstate)/homes). outzip >= outstate held for all 372 Hawaii tracts, consistent with outzip counting all out-of-ZIP owners.
Tract-to-district assignment is by tract centroid; tracts straddling TMK zone lines are assigned wholly to one zone.

Oahu_summary.reading: Regrid 'out of state' tracks the roll's OTHER-US-STATE share (foreign apparently excluded) closely on Oahu, but runs low on Maui, especially in condo-heavy zones (Lahaina, Kihei/Wailuku) where Regrid counts far fewer homes than the roll (condo units appear to be dropped by the residential/building filter). Expect the Hawaii County figures to understate non-Hawaii ownership in condo/resort areas (Kona, South Kohala).

Maui County_summary.reading: Regrid 'out of state' tracks the roll's OTHER-US-STATE share (foreign apparently excluded) closely on Oahu, but runs low on Maui, especially in condo-heavy zones (Lahaina, Kihei/Wailuku) where Regrid counts far fewer homes than the roll (condo units appear to be dropped by the residential/building filter). Expect the Hawaii County figures to understate non-Hawaii ownership in condo/resort areas (Kona, South Kohala).

caveats: County layer from 2021 (PUBDATE 12/16/20), vacation-rental class (CLASS = 2) records only; 1,029 records vs 3,974 TY26 vacation-rental-class records, so it is a subset (selection rule undocumented).

KAUAIOWN / HIOWN flag method is undocumented (presumably owner mailing address on Kauai / elsewhere in Hawaii). 'neither_flag' is therefore an UPPER-BOUND style proxy for non-Hawaii ownership, not a measured out-of-state share.

County Housing Agency review layer (tax year 2025): parcels/CPR units whose first owner is an LLC. Ownership TYPE, not mailing location. Class totals used for the approximate share come from TY26_PropertyTaxData (tax year 2026), so shares are approximate.
